supply_registration: SUPPLY-001 (PREMISE-001/007); human_supply executed by AI with audit layer, pending external audit; explicitly NOT user supply
purpose: Two counting processes converge to the same result value but at different rounds; the pinned delay equivalence identifies them (the arrival round is forgotten, which is the theory treating the counting process as an already-completed result sequence). A completion-sensitive consumer declared in advance adds its own processing steps on top of the count, and a declared termination boundary then observes whether the consumer completed in time. Find whether the declared consumer completes within the boundary on one result-equivalent counter and misses it on the other, so that a verification task whose correctness depends on the counting process terminating is decided by the very round the equivalence erased.

source_basis.kind: AI-frozen new task family over the pinned existing delay model (GEN-001 supply, not user supply)
references: PREMISE-001/005 shard entry PREMISE-A-03 (Nat: counting process treated as an already-completed result sequence)
Atria的方案/修订片/003 (GEN-001 nine-field task specification and role discipline)

input.type_ref: ground terms of Delay Bool: omega or ret n b with n <= 2 (declared grammar L1-COMPLETION-PROCESS-v1)
input.available_information: only what the pinned model's constructors and operations expose

environment.arrival_policy: synchronous rounds; a bind adds its own processing rounds on top of the producer's arrival round; a race returns the earlier-arriving branch, left priority on ties
environment.nondeterminism: none inside the fragment (single-thread deterministic delay)
environment.fairness: synchronous rounds with left priority on ties, as pinned

observation.value: Bool carried by ret, and Optional Bool carried by a deadline observation
observation.trace: round index n is carried by ret and accumulated by bind, but is invisible to delay equivalence
observation.time_structure: discrete synchronous rounds only; no continuity or physical-time claim

completion.criterion_ref: a declared deadline k observes whether the composed process (counter, then completion-sensitive consumer) arrives within k rounds; the consumer's branch structure models a verification procedure that completes on the in-boundary outcome and misses the boundary on the late outcome

allowed_resources: finite enumeration budget; one native kernel check per selected witness plus positive and negative controls
prohibited_extra_information: the completion-sensitive consumer may not use information the original task was declared not to hold: no labels, no branch tags, no oracle. The termination boundary and the consumer are declared consumers of the same original activity and are declared up front.
assumptions: the fragment is the pinned delay model, not general Nat induction, general well-foundedness or general coinduction

the delay equivalence models the theory's identification of two result-equivalent counters only in the bounded sense that it forgets the arrival round; this is a bounded modelling correspondence, not a claim that Delay Bool is HoTT's Nat eliminator
the bind models the verification procedure's own processing steps only as a constant round shift, and the deadline models a declared termination boundary, not a physical deadline
no physical-time or implementation claim is made
obligations: the verified statement must be a ground instance inside the declared grammar
at least one witness must bind a continuation declared only in L1-COMPLETION-PROCESS-v1, proving the family is outside l1-v0/v1/v2
the separating consumer must be one of the declared consumers, not an oracle added after seeing a candidate
an exploration instance must not be upgraded into a new mathematical claim

known_positive_controls.note: expected separation: the in-boundary counter composes with the completion-sensitive consumer into a process arriving at round 2, observed inside the boundary; the late counter shifts to round 3 and misses it. External benchmark only; the search is not given this answer.

known_negative_controls.description: a deadline horizon at or above both raw counter round indices cannot separate a result-equivalent pair without the completion-sensitive consumer

correspondence.original_activity: a counting process whose result is consumed by a verification procedure that must complete within a declared termination boundary; the correctness of the verification depends on whether the count terminated in time
theoryization_steps: model each counter as a single-thread deterministic delay, identified up to delay equivalence (this is the theory's step: the arrival round, i.e. when the count terminated, is forgotten and the process is treated as its already-completed result)
model the verification procedure as a declared bind continuation whose own processing rounds are added on top of the count
model the termination boundary as a declared deadline observing the composed process
correspondence.observation_justification: the consumer and the boundary are declared in the pinned model; the deadline reads only the accumulated round index the model already carries
preservation_claims: the input domain, the value type and the completion requirement are unchanged from the task declaration
only the declared consumers are applied; no extra branch information is exposed
open_obligations: the Delay Bool fragment is a bounded correspondent of the A-03 counting-process premise, not HoTT's Nat eliminator itself; a coinductive / guarded-clock family remains a V2 candidate
a real consumer (E6-style) is out of scope for this bounded acceptance unit
the physical reading of a deadline is not addressed by this fragment
